subject.title: fix: add exact and prefix skill search modes

question: Should ClawHub accept `mode=prefix|exact` on `/api/v1/search` plus `clawhub search --prefix/--exact` as the stable discovery surface for https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/1383, or should this move to a cursor-paginated list/filter API before merge?
rationale: This is a new public API and CLI behavior, and the linked issue asked for reliable enumeration/counting rather than only ranked search; automation cannot choose the long-term contract for maintainers.

options.title: Accept explicit search modes after proof and docs
options.body: Keep the PR's additive API/CLI shape, require public docs plus live prefix/exact proof, and track pagination or count workflows separately if needed.

options.title: Require a paginated list/filter contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to revise toward a cursor-pageable registry discovery endpoint or list mode before this closes the linked issue.

options.title: Defer the public API direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers write down the desired discovery contract for exact, prefix, pagination, and moderation visibility.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit search modes after proof and docs
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's additive API/CLI shape, require public docs plus live prefix/exact proof, and track pagination or count workflows separately if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current API, CLI, and search surfaces blame to Patrick-Erichsen's recent baseline and adjacent API work, making them the best available routing owner for the public contract choice.
